name: zeffect_conditional_ref_pos_distance_sq
description: zEffect::GetConditionalRefPosDistanceSq returns zero when world-position lookup fails, otherwise squared distance from the current conditional reference position.
known_limits: Binary Ninja HLIL misrenders the final x87 expression as only dz; assembly and LLIL show dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz. tier S verification was not attempted in this session.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x45c640 validates gwNode::GetWorldPosition, zero return on lookup failure, subtraction of the global conditional reference position, and x87 accumulation of dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz.
The native zEffect conditional-reference smoke verifies null/failure return and a 3-4-5 fixture producing squared distance 50.
